title: Software Critical for TSOs to Enhance Grid Resilience, ABI Research Finds
author: Abi Research
description: A survey of 151 Transmission System Operators across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific reveals that cybersecurity is their top concern. TSOs are increasing software investments in Energy Management Systems, grid planning software, and Grid Enhancing Technologies to modernize aging infrastructure and expand grid capacity. Vendors are advised to emphasize security credibility, interoperability, and operational value rather than relying solely on AI differentiation.

title: Should First Trust Dow 30 Equal Weight ETF (EDOW) Be on Your Investing Radar?

title: Why Honeywell International Inc. (HON) Dipped More Than Broader Market Today
author: Zacks.Com
description: Honeywell International (HON) declined 1.12% on October 13, 2026, underperforming the S&P 500's 0.02% loss. The stock faces significant headwinds with expected Q3 EPS down 61.52% and revenue down 51.31% year-over-year. Full-year guidance shows earnings declining 57.72% and revenue falling 49.55%. The company holds a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating with a Forward P/E of 25.34, trading at a premium to its industry average of 12.81.

title: Should You Buy Zebra Technologies Stock After a 71% Rally in 6 Months?
author: Zacks.Com
description: Zebra Technologies (ZBRA) has surged 71.3% over six months, outperforming the S&P 500's 14.1% gain. The company benefits from strong demand for mobile computing, printing, machine vision, and RFID solutions across retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Recent acquisitions of Elo Touch and Photoneo expand its addressable market. With free cash flow rising 25.3% and ~$700 million in planned 2026 share repurchases, plus bullish technical indicators and 33.5% expected earnings growth, Zacks rates ZBRA as a Buy.
